description.from:
Run the canonical evaluator over the pinned corpus and freeze the result as baseline series 1.

Official run: scanner `develop`, pinned materializations verified against manifests, accepted gold only, AI inference disabled, canonical evaluator.

**Series 1 records `predecessor: none`.** There is no prior contract to bridge from: `benchmark:run` has never been published as a baseline on scanner `develop`, the last full run used the `dataparade-cli` copy with the pre-fix mixed runner, and `precision.ts` is wrong in a known direction (cross-layer scope). Manufacturing a bridge run from any of those would create false continuity. The artifact schema must permit a series with no predecessor.

Thereafter: detector changes are compared against the frozen artifact and never overwrite it; gold or contract changes start a new immutable series with a bridge run against the same scanner commit.
description.to:
Run the canonical evaluator over the pinned corpus and freeze baseline series 1 only after the readiness gate passes.

Official run: scanner `develop`; verified pinned materializations; accepted canonical gold only; AI inference disabled; canonical evaluator and four-layer scorecard.

The command first produces readiness evidence and refuses to freeze on accepted legacy identities, unresolved endpoints, source-token-only gold, inadequate layer count/diversity, unreviewed scopes, path-contract errors above the limit, or unscorable rates above the limit.

Series 1 records `predecessor: none`. There is no trustworthy prior contract to bridge from. Thereafter detector changes compare against the frozen artifact; gold/contract changes create an immutable successor with a same-scanner bridge run.

Definition of done: JSON and generated Markdown are committed, fingerprints validate, readiness is green, and rerunning the same inputs reproduces byte-identical semantic content.
